title: How Much Does Grooming Salon Marketing Cost? | Perform Pets

facts.fact: Grooming salon marketing from an agency that works with pet businesses costs about $750 to $5,000 or more a month for ongoing work in 2026, per the page's review of published agency prices.
facts.quote: costs about $750 to $5,000 or more a month for ongoing work in 2026

facts.fact: The page's price review covered 46 pet and veterinary agency websites.
facts.quote: a November 2026 review of 46 pet and veterinary agency websites

facts.fact: The published agency prices were checked on October 14, 2026.
facts.quote: checked on October 14, 2026

facts.fact: TailWerks publishes an ongoing multi-channel package of $997 to $3,247 a month across three tiers, with entry requirements for the top tier.
facts.quote: $997 to $3,247 a month across three tiers

facts.fact: Perform Pets publishes an ongoing multi-channel package from $2,000 a month for one location.
facts.quote: From $2,000 a month, one location

facts.fact: Pet Engine Marketing publishes an ongoing partnership generally starting from $2,500 a month.
facts.quote: Generally from $2,500 a month

facts.fact: Paw Point Marketing does not publish its management fee and requires at least $600 a month in ad spend for its paid ads program.
facts.quote: requires at least $600 a month in ad spend

facts.fact: Ad spend is not included in any of the published agency monthly fees.
facts.quote: Ad spend is not included in any of these fees.

facts.fact: Perform Pets publishes a website build cost of $3,000 once.
facts.quote: $3,000 once

facts.fact: Pet Marketing Unleashed publishes a branded website build from $7,600 once.
facts.quote: From $7,600 once

facts.fact: MoeGo's mobile grooming booking software plans cost $49 to $159 a month, with higher plans priced per van.
facts.quote: $49 to $159 a month; the higher plans are priced per van

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 search advertising benchmarks, the Animals & Pets category averaged $4.06 per click.
facts.quote: $4.06 per click.

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 search advertising benchmarks, the Animals & Pets category had a 16.22% conversion rate.
facts.quote: A 16.22% conversion rate

facts.fact: In LocaliQ's 2026 search advertising benchmarks, the Animals & Pets category averaged $31.50 per lead.
facts.quote: $31.50 per lead.

facts.fact: Woof & Wash Pet Grooming, a client of the page's author, averaged about $5 per tracked conversion over five months in 2026.
facts.quote: averaged about $5 per tracked conversion over five months in 2026

facts.fact: Gartner's 2025 CMO Spend Survey of 402 marketing leaders found marketing budgets averaged 7.7% of company revenue across all industries.
facts.quote: Gartner’s 2025 CMO Spend Survey of 402 marketing leaders found budgets averaged 7.7% of company revenue

facts.fact: The American Kennel Club suggests trimming a Poodle's coat about every four to eight weeks.
facts.quote: every four to eight weeks

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey of 1,002 US adults, 74% said they look for reviews written in the last three months.
facts.quote: 74% said they look for reviews written in the last three months

facts.fact: In BrightLocal's 2026 Local Consumer Review Survey of 1,002 US adults, 47% said they would not use a business with fewer than 20 reviews.
facts.quote: 47% said they would not use a business with fewer than 20 reviews

facts.fact: Grooming salon marketing from an agency that works with pet businesses costs about $750 to $5,000 or more a month for ongoing work, per the page's review of 46 pet and veterinary agency websites, which it describes as their listed range rather than an industry average.
facts.quote: costs about $750 to $5,000 or more a month for ongoing work, based on a November 2026 review of 46 pet and veterinary agency websites.

facts.fact: In LocaliQ 2026 benchmarks, the Animals and Pets category averaged $4.06 per click and $31.50 per lead on search ads (third-party data).
facts.quote: the Animals and Pets category averaged $4.06 per click and $31.50 per lead on search ads.

facts.fact: MoeGo lists plans for mobile groomers from $49 to $159 a month, with higher plans priced per van (third-party software pricing as cited by the page).
facts.quote: MoeGo lists plans for mobile groomers from $49 to $159 a month, with the higher plans priced per van.

facts.fact: Gartner found large companies across all industries averaged 7.7% of revenue on marketing in 2025 (third-party figure).
facts.quote: Gartner found large companies across all industries averaged 7.7% of revenue on marketing in 2025

facts.fact: One agency the page reviewed requires at least $600 a month in ad spend.
facts.quote: One requires at least $600 a month in ad spend.

facts.fact: Published agency prices used by the page were checked on October 14, 2026, and prices may change, so buyers should confirm with each company.
facts.quote: checked October 14, 2026. Prices change, so confirm with each company.

facts.fact: The page's worked example assumes a $2,000 monthly agency fee plus $600 in ad spend, totaling $2,600 a month.
facts.quote: A $2,000 fee plus $600 in ads is $2,600 a month, so a salon allowing $90 to win a client needs about 29 new clients a month

facts.fact: The page's example assumes a salon allows $90 to win a client, which would need about 29 new clients a month to cover a $2,600 monthly cost.
facts.quote: a salon allowing $90 to win a client needs about 29 new clients a month to stay within that limit.

facts.fact: The page recommends starting with one channel and measuring cost per booked groom for 90 days before widening it.
facts.quote: Start with one channel, measure cost per booked groom for 90 days, then widen it.
